name: Encrypted Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, the Encrypted Sigil carries a summons to newly awakened night elf rogues. Frahun Shadewhisper calls them to begin training as dangers gather around Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Hidden Summons
sections.body: New night elf scouts and infiltrators in Shadowglen receive the Encrypted Sigil through discreet means. A quiet messenger delivers it on behalf of Frahun Shadewhisper. Its contents are hidden instructions that tell the initiate to report to Frahun near Aldrassil. Reading and delivering the token shows Frahun that an initiate can follow subtle directions and handle covert messages.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Frahun uses the summons to explain why rogues matter in an unsettled world. Tensions simmer between the night elves and the distant Horde, but open warfare is not the only danger facing their people. Rogues must gather intelligence across Teldrassil as the Kaldorei’s unseen eyes and blades, and learn to strike before threats take root in the World Tree’s boughs.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Sigil?
aliases: why do i have encrypted sigil
faq.answer: The Encrypted Sigil summons novice night elf rogues to begin training. Its hidden instructions direct you to report to Frahun Shadewhisper near Aldrassil.
Frahun Shadewhisper sends the Encrypted Sigil. He is the rogue trainer in Shadowglen beneath Aldrassil’s boughs.

faq.q: What does Frahun Shadewhisper want with me?
faq.answer: Frahun wants to judge your readiness, teach you about dangers facing the night elves, including possible discord stirred by the Horde, and give you basic combat instruction.

faq.q: Where should I take the sigil once I read it?
faq.answer: Take the sigil to Frahun Shadewhisper near Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

angles.text: As a rogue, you begin your path by following the sigil’s hidden instructions and making contact with your mentor.
As a night elf, you know covert operatives gather vital intelligence while the Kaldorei face new encroachment from the Horde. This is a fragile era.
